kurzbeschreibung: East Tirol is the sun-drenched high valley nestled between the jagged peaks of the **Hohe Tauern** and the **Lienzer Dolomiten**.
beschreibung: East Tyrol is Austria’s sunniest district and a paradise for mountain lovers. The district of Lienz is surrounded by the mighty peaks of the Hohe Tauern National Park in the north and the striking Lienzer Dolomites in the south. The district capital, Lienz, charms with its medieval old town and Schloss Bruck. Matrei in Osttirol serves as the gateway to the national park and is the starting point for hikes to the Großglockner (3,798 m), Austria’s highest mountain. Kals am Großglockner is the key base for Großglockner ascents, featuring the famous Kalser Höhenweg trail.
tipps: Der Kalser Höhenweg ist eine anspruchsvolle Mehrtagestour – Trittsicherheit unbedingt erforderlich.
Der Nationalpark Hohe Tauern bietet kostenlose geführte Rangertouren an.
Die Großglockner-Hochalpenstraße führt direkt zum Fuscher Törl – ein unvergessliches Panorama.
empfehlungen: Explore the Nationalpark Hohe Tauern and hike along the Kalser Höhenweg by the Glocknerwand. Afterwards, stop by the Lucknerhaus in Kals for authentic Osttiroler Kasnocken.
umgebung: East Tyrol (Osttirol) is accessible from North Tyrol (Nordtirol) via the Felbertauern Tunnel. To the south, it borders South Tyrol (Südtirol, Italy), and to the east, it borders Carinthia (Kärnten). The High Tauern (Hohe Tauern) in the north separate East Tyrol from Salzburg. Neighboring regions include the Defereggen Valley (Defereggental) to the west, the Virgental Valley (Virgental) to the south, and the Isel Valley (Iseltal) to the east.
